Independent phase modulation removes the unwanted side images that off-axis and interleaved schemes generate, so less energy is lost
The mimic octopus alters its body shape to resemble sea snakes or lionfish according to its circumstances
The iterative Fourier transform algorithm computes the four-level phase profile for a target holographic image
FDTD with a Drude model for the gold permittivity computes the reflectance and the near fields of the unit cell
Cedar oil has refractive index n = 1.515 against n = 1 for air
Traditional multiwavelength metasurface holograms use off-axis illumination or interleaved subarrays, whose phases are not independent
A phase-only hologram reconstructs its image by diffraction, so the image depends only on the per-pixel phase map
Working efficiency is defined as the integrated hologram intensity divided by the light incident on the sample
Reflection dips A and B move from about 0.65 and 0.95 um in air to about 0.80 and 1.25 um in oil

notes: No full text (Wiley); text_source is captions_plus_linked_text, so every processing number, the phase values 0/pi, the P1/P2 matrices and all working efficiencies are text with requires_unseen. Supporting figures S2-S8 (optical setup, efficiency, focusing sweeps) are not in the packet. Spine: two branches that meet at the conclusion - the single-wavelength bird/fish device (n1..n12, efficiency n17) and the dual-wavelength DC/IU device (n13..n16, efficiency n19); n8 (oil immersion) is shared by both and is the joint cause of n16 with n15. n8 causes n9 directly, skipping STR, because nothing in the solid changes: only the surroundings do. Packet defects found by reading the images: (i) the Fig. 2 caption prints W1 = 700 nm and g = 40 nm while the linked text gives W1 = 100 nm and g = 50 nm; (ii) the Fig. 4 caption prints W3 = 700 nm, which cannot fit a 500 nm period and is most likely 100 nm; (iii) the Fig. 4 and Fig. 5 captions say 770 nm while the Fig. 5c annotations and the linked text both say 710 nm - the figure wins, so 710 nm is used; (iv) the F5b crop's OCR panel letter is read as q and flagged as disagreeing, but the crop is panel (b), the SEM image. Technique/cue conflict: crop F5c carries cue class micrograph, which does not admit a SIM technique, so the simulated-hologram node o9 cites the whole figure F5 with panel_ids [] while the measured-hologram nodes o10 and a2 cite F5c as OPTICAL. F2a, F2b, F4a and F4b are schematics, so they are attached to the HYP/DES nodes they illustrate rather than typed as OBS. Three audits: a1 (blurred, broken measured bird/fish) and a2 (zero-order background on the oil/710 nm channel, fragmented C) qualify the two performance claims; a3 (at 800 nm the simulated reflection is ~0.8 in air but ~0.2 in oil) is text-silent and qualifies the efficiency claim, and explains why the oil efficiency is the lower of the pair. Dropped as off-argument: the 1.2 um shoulder in Fig. 2c, the exact colour-bar maxima (kept in image_note), and the supporting-information focusing sweeps.
